# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbrace)
```

Create simplified records function:

```{r load-functions}
create_records_simple <- function(extinction_time, pse) {
  repeat {
    counts <- rpois(extinction_time, pse)
    if (any(counts[1:extinction_time] > 0)) break
  }

  records <- rep(seq_along(counts), counts)

  return(records)
}
```

Set seed for reproducibility:

```{r seed}
set.seed(1234)
```

# Figure

## A Extinct

```{r a-extinct}
A_Extinct_data_1 <- create_records_simple(100, 0.175)
A_Extinct_data_2 <- create_records_simple(100, 0.175)

A_Extinct_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timelines
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 200, y = 1),
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 200, y = 2),
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Extinction Time
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 100,
    linetype = "33",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Test Times
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 150, ymin = 1, ymax = 1.25),
    linetype = "11",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 120, ymin = 2, ymax = 2.25),
    linetype = "11",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extinct_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extinct_data_2, y = 2),
    size = 2
  ) +
  # Brackets
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(101, 149), y = c(0.9, 0.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey"
  ) +
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(101, 119), y = c(1.9, 1.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 200), y = c(0.725, 2.275)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")) +
  labs(subtitle = "Extinct")
```

## A Extant

```{r a-extant}
A_Extant_data_1 <- create_records_simple(80, 0.175) # fudge so that we get a gap
A_Extant_data_2 <- create_records_simple(95, 0.175) # fudge so that we get a gap

A_Extant_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timelines
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 100, y = 1),
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 100, y = 2),
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Test Times
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 100, ymin = 1, ymax = 1.25),
    linetype = "11",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 100, ymin = 2, ymax = 2.25),
    linetype = "11",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extant_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extant_data_2, y = 2),
    size = 2
  ) +
  # Brackets
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(max(A_Extant_data_1) + 1, 99), y = c(0.9, 0.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey"
  ) +
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(max(A_Extant_data_2) + 1, 99), y = c(1.9, 1.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 100), y = c(0.725, 2.275)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")) +
  labs(subtitle = "Extant")
```

## A All

```{r a-all}
A_plot <- ggarrange(
  A_Extinct_plot, NULL, A_Extant_plot,
  ncol = 3, widths = c(1, 0.1, 1)
)

A_plot <- annotate_figure(
  A_plot,
  top = text_grob(
    "A) Scenario A: Gaps in the Sighting Record",
    x = 0, hjust = 0, size = 13.2
  )
)
```
